build_dummy_metadata_json: run the CLI to scan a game folder for game_*.json files and dump dummy metadata as JSON
create_ratings_table: create a ratings table dictionary with dummy entries for each game ID and power found in the folder
run_make_ratings_table: run make_ratings_table to extract game IDs from game_*.json files and build a stats dictionary
refactor_make_ratings_table: refactor make_ratings_table to support custom press types or additional rating fields per power
review_make_ratings_table: review make_ratings_table to understand how it parses game IDs and initializes dummy stats for all POWERS
